purpose: Expose the notestr-forgotten-slots IDB store to e2e tests via three targeted additions: add the store name to the cleanup KNOWN_IDB_NAMES array, declare the window hook type, and implement the hook inside the existing E2E test-hooks block in client.tsx.

public_api.name: __notestrTestForgottenSlots
public_api.description: Window hook registered inside the NEXT_PUBLIC_E2E === '1' block in client.tsx. Returns the current keys of the notestr-forgotten-slots IDB store as a string[]. Returns an empty array (not null/undefined) when the store is empty.

dependencies_allowed: src/marmot/forgotten-slots.ts (loadForgottenSlots — consumed via dynamic import inside hook)
dependencies_forbidden: e2e/tests/ (S6 and S7 own all test-spec files)
test_targets: Exercised by S6's clearAppState() call (KNOWN_IDB_NAMES addition)
Exercised by S7's page.evaluate(() => window.__notestrTestForgottenSlots()) call (hook + type declaration)

insertion_points.description: Append 'notestr-forgotten-slots' to the KNOWN_IDB_NAMES array (after 'notestr-joined-groups'). Array is not strictly alphabetized so append with a comment noting the source story S5.

Add __notestrTestForgottenSlots?: () => Promise<string[]> to the Window interface, alongside existing __notestrTest* declarations. Optional ? per existing convention — hook only exists when NEXT_PUBLIC_E2E === '1'.

Inside the existing useEffect guarded by isTestRuntime() (line ~415), after the __notestrTestArmAutoInvite assignment and before the cleanup return function, add: window.__notestrTestForgottenSlots = async () => { const { loadForgottenSlots } = await import('./forgotten-slots'); const slots = await loadForgottenSlots(); return Array.from(slots); }; Also add 'delete window.__notestrTestForgottenSlots' to the cleanup return. Uses lazy import to avoid loading forgotten-slots into the non-E2E bundle.
